| Category = Fruit recipes
| Difficulty = 1

{{recipe}} 

== Ingredients ==
* 4 [[Cookbook:Peach|peaches]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] into eighths
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Crystallized ginger|crystallized ginger]], crushed
* 4 [[Cookbook:Plum|plums]], quartered
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tbsp|tbsp]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ½ cup (1 stick) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], divided
* 6 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Brandy|brandy]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 1 tbsp finely-grated [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] zest

== Procedure ==
#In a large bowl, [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|toss]] together fruit, sugar, salt, lemon, and brandy. Set aside.
#In four large sheets of [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]], scatter a foundation of crystallized ginger.
#Place the fruit mixture on top of the ginger. Top with 1 tablespoon of the butter. Fold into a pouch.
#Place pouches in the hot coal area of a kettle [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]]. Cook 7 minutes. Serve warm.
